crew.overview: A gorilla named Ivan who’s living in a suburban shopping mall tries to piece together his past, with the help of other animals, as they hatch a plan to escape from captivity.
crew.title: The One and Only Ivan

crew.overview: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.
crew.title: Captain America: Civil War

crew.overview: As Emily struggles to fit in at home and at school, she discovers a small red puppy who is destined to become her best friend. When Clifford magically undergoes one heck of a growth spurt, becomes a gigantic dog and attracts the attention of a genetics company, Emily and her Uncle Casey have to fight the forces of greed as they go on the run across New York City. Along the way, Clifford affects the lives of everyone around him and teaches Emily and her uncle the true meaning of acceptance and unconditional love.
crew.title: Clifford the Big Red Dog

details.biography:
Victor Rivas Alvarez is a visual effects supervisor and Head of Studio with 19 years of experience working in film production and post-production. He founded a company called Varita Filmica in 2012. Offering his post-production services for different clients around Puerto Rico in commercials, music videos. Varita Filmica, was the company that gave life and brand to the Daikin company, creating the company's robot called Air-Con. This led him to the opportunity to successfully take off where he worked on different movies such as Captain America: Civil War with the Russo brothers in the production of the set taking photographs and scanning for post production. As Digital Composer in the film Todo X Sara, Dos Caminos, Replicas, serving different identities in Puerto Rico. After those collaborations, it opened ways for him to lead a team of twenty people in the industry for film production in production and post-production.

He and his team worked in advertising, film, music videos. This ended when Hurricane Maria hit Puerto Rico in 2017 where his company was affected for ten months without customers, until filing for bankruptcy in 2018. But he never gave up. He started over in a different way, working with ABC as a Visual Effects Supervisor for a television show called Primetime. In 2019, he was responsible for creating and selling the Visual Effects between Mexico and Puerto Rico, creating a "Crowd Engine" for the demonstration of the Menudo (Subete A Mi Moto) series. In 2019 with MPC Film, as a Digital Compositor for different films, such as Maleficent Mistress of Evil, Noelle, The Big Red Dog (Clifford), The One and Only Ivan, which won HPA Awards for the best visual effects in 2020.

With vast experience in visual effects, cinematography, computer programming, combining technology with arts. In 2021 and 2022 , the company began serving different brands such as Netflix, NBC, Univision, Toyota. Creating reliability in the visual effects process internationally and positioning its company name and founder on another scale. Collaboration between companies such as The Mill, Ingenuity Studios, Harbor Picture Company, Company 3, Alkemy X, mentioning some of them has established a professionalism in the industry. Victor Rivas will be making his directorial debut with The Hot Asopao in 2025.
details.name: Victor Rivas Alvarez
